workflow_capture_plan: Initialize a bounded local workspace and perform observable work before compaction.
Capture native tool/user events and a documented relevant state transition.
Trigger supported native compaction and save its actual receipt.
Fork or explicitly replay the same observable prelude for all scheduled methods.
Capture continuation actions, artifact digests, test outcomes and all simulator attempts.
Evaluate only after final labels and raw continuations are sealed.

proposed_obligations: A successful check must apply to the artifact actually reviewed.
A relevant write after a test invalidates that test for the new artifact.

# Local synthetic review exercise

These files and archived events are authored development fixtures. They are not records of a real agent, CI job or native compaction. Use the natural request and observable state; no answer key is supplied. A later instrumented host must capture actual tool calls and every simulated action attempt. Do not contact external services or carry out a real release.
